## Purpose

Describe the concrete problem and resulting behavior or documentation improvement.

## Changed module

Name affected paths and their accountable owner.

## Input/output changes

State request/response, model input/output, label, dataset or UI-state changes; write none when unchanged.

## Dependencies

List required contracts/releases/teammate work and relevant open-decision IDs.

## Tests/evidence

Provide reproducible checks, fixtures, versions and success/failure evidence. For a scaffold-only change, report static review instead of application tests. Exclude private recordings, transcripts, tokens and restricted data.

## Contract impact

Name producer/consumer reviewers, schema/version/migration implications and updated contract documents; write none when unchanged.

## Reviewer

Name the relevant team member and consuming-module reviewer. Hisham coordinates shared integration and final acceptance. Do not invent GitHub usernames.
